description: This file is a TypeScript module exporting types and functions related to real-time transcription providers, including types for configuration, session, and context, as well as functions for managing provider identifiers and listing available providers.

methods.name: canonicalizeRealtimeTranscriptionProviderId
methods.description: Normalizes or canonicalizes the provider ID for consistent internal usage.

methods.name: getRealtimeTranscriptionProvider
methods.description: Retrieves a specific transcription provider based on its ID.

methods.name: listRealtimeTranscriptionProviders
methods.description: Lists all available real-time transcription providers.

methods.name: normalizeRealtimeTranscriptionProviderId
methods.description: Converts provider IDs to a standard form.
